notes: The only change from v1: the duplication rule now checks the last character of the **last word** (not the whole stripped string) and duplicates unless that character is an uppercase letter. This fixes `"hello WORLD"` (no dup, since 'D' is uppercase) and `"abc def GHI"` (no dup, 'I' uppercase), while keeping all other E1/E2 cases correct.
